pins.title: Ratford
pins.description: Ratford - a bandit. He hunts in the area around the Old Camp, together with his friend, Drax.

pins.title: Bloodwyn
pins.description: Bloodwyn. A warder at the Old Camp. He collects protection money in the northern part of the camp. He acts friendly, but is far from trustworthy.

pins.title: Fletcher
pins.description: Fletcher - a warder at the Old Camp's Outer Ring. He collects protection money from the diggers and all newcomers.

pins.title: Bullit
pins.description: Bulllit. The guy who welcomed my face with his fist.

pins.title: Kirgo
pins.description: Kirgo's a fighter in the arena. One of the few friendly faces around here. He's not out for trouble, more for the human side of things.

pins.title: Orry
pins.description: Orry. He's a warder at the Exchange Zone. Knows his way around and doesn't mind sharing his knowledge.

pins.title: Brannok
pins.description: Brannok is guarding a door inside a cave.

pins.title: Quentin
pins.description: I met Quentin, the outlaws' leader. His hut's in the center of their camp.

pins.title: Jacko
pins.description: Jacko produces herb (secretly) and sells it.

pins.title: Killian
pins.description: Killian. A bandit. Doesn't talk much.

pins.title: Renyu
pins.description: Renyu's a bandit. He guards the cave where they produce the herb.

pins.title: Torik
pins.description: Torik trades supplies in Quentin's camp.

pins.title: Gorn
pins.description: Gorn is a mercenary. A strong fighter. Calm, steady as a rock. His presence shows determination and experience. He doesn't need many words to command respect. He's not someone you want as an enemy.

pins.title: Okyl
pins.description: Okyl's a mercenary in the Cauldron, at the Free Mine.

pins.title: Baloro
pins.description: Baloro is a mercenary in the Cauldron, at the Free Mine.

pins.title: Jackal
pins.description: Jackal. One of the warders at the Outer Ring. Asked for his protection money.

pins.title: Cord
pins.description: Cord - a mercenary. He could teach me in one-handed combat. Mostly close to the lake (during the day).

pins.title: Swiney
pins.description: Swiney is the scrapers' foreman in the Cauldron, at the Free Mine.

pins.title: Lester
pins.description: The novice Lester is a funny guy. I can't tell if he's smoked too much weed, but he seems relaxed and pretty helpful. He can show me around the Swamp Camp and point out the important places.

pins.title: Grim
pins.description: Grim. Digger at the Old Camp.

pins.title: Butch
pins.description: Butch is a bandit.

pins.title: Torlof
pins.description: Torlof is a mercenary - he was a mate in the royal fleet.

pins.title: Lee
pins.description: Lee is leader of the mercenaries.

pins.title: Shrat
pins.description: Shrat - a novice. He's looking for someone to roam the area with him.

pins.title: Mud
pins.description: Mud. Digger at the Old Camp.

pins.title: Rice Lord
pins.description: Rice Lord. He sits in his fortress and oversees the farmers' work from there. (Actual name is Hakon.)

pins.title: Roscoe
pins.description: Roscoe is guarding Lares' hut. He'll never let me pass without a good reason.

pins.title: Jarvis
pins.description: Jarvis is a mercenary - he guards the gate to the New Camp.

pins.title: Milten
pins.description: Milten. Fire Mage. (Young.)

pins.title: Pock
pins.description: Pock is a farmer on the rice fields.

pins.title: Rufus
pins.description: Rufus works on the rice fields.

pins.title: Haenno
pins.description: Haenno is a mercenary.

pins.title: Nefarius
pins.description: Nefarius - a Water Mage. Whatever he is up to, he seems busy.

pins.title: Shrike
pins.description: Shrike. A bandit in the New Camp. He hangs around with the mercenaries. Doesn't actually belong there. (Meaning: No one's gonna cover his back.)

pins.title: Myxir
pins.description: One of the Water Mages. Myxir. He seems absent-minded, lost in thought.

pins.title: Merdarion
pins.description: Merdarion. Usually in the Water Mages' cave in the New Camp, studying. He seems annoyed. One of those who just want to be left alone.

pins.title: Rayk
pins.description: Rayk - a drunkard and a bully. Tendency to cause trouble at the tavern in the New Camp. I'll find a way to make him stop. One way or another.

pins.title: Nyras
pins.description: Nyras. One of the novices.

pins.title: Chokta
pins.description: Chokta. An orc at the Enclave.

pins.title: Gor Hanis
pins.description: Gor Hanis. Templar. Arena fighter at the Old Camp.

pins.title: Kharim
pins.description: Kharim is an arena fighter in the Old Camp. Pretty convinced of his own skills.

pins.title: Baal Taran
pins.description: Baal Taran spreads the teachings of the Sleeper.

pins.title: Gravo
pins.description: Gravo can put in a good word for me if I ever get in trouble at the Camp. (Not for free, though.)

pins.title: Snaf
pins.description: Snaf is a cook at the Outer Ring of the Old Camp.

pins.title: Arlin
pins.description: Arlin is one of the outlaws. He's locked up in the Old Camp's dungeon.

pins.title: Seraphia
pins.description: Serpahia is a prisoner of the ore barons.

pins.title: Ian
pins.description: Ian runs the Old Mine. Constantly busy, he tries to keep the place under control.

pins.title: Arto
pins.description: Arto is one of Gomez' bodyguards.

pins.title: Bartholo
pins.description: Bartholo. Ore baron. He's the steward of the Old Camp.

pins.title: Scar
pins.description: Scar. One of Gomez' bodyguards.

pins.title: Cutter
pins.description: Cutter. Warder at the castle.

pins.title: Aaron
pins.description: Aaron is a warder at the Old Mine.

pins.title: Gomez
pins.description: Gomez. Leader of the Old Camp. He sits in the castle. He decides who is admitted. He decides who lives. Underestimating him is a deadly mistake.

pins.title: Drago
pins.description: Drago. Fire Mage.

pins.title: Guy
pins.description: Guy. Digger at the Old Camp.

pins.title: Jesse
pins.description: Jesse - a digger at the Old Camp.

pins.title: Dusty
pins.description: Dusty. A digger at the Old Camp.

pins.title: Herek
pins.description: Herek. A digger at the Old Camp. Bragged about killing a dozen people with his bare hands. Hard to believe.

pins.title: Sly
pins.description: Sly's a Shadow at the Old Camp.

pins.title: Stone
pins.description: Stone is the Old Camp's blacksmith.

pins.title: Rodriguez
pins.description: Rodrigues. Fire Mage.

pins.title: Velaya
pins.description: Velaya. She's a prisoner of the ore barons. Got thrown into the Colony the same time I did.

pins.title: Raven
pins.description: Raven. One of the ore barons. Gomez's right hand. Knows a lot, and gives a lot of orders.

pins.title: Kyle
pins.description: Kyle - a digger at the Old Camp. Has a hut built directly onto the path.

pins.title: Whistler
pins.description: Whislter's a Shadow at the Old Camp. He has a hut close to the marketplace. Met him at the marketplace. (Knows how to talk and who's worth his time.) (Seems like the one thing they all agree on is that nothing's for free in here.)

pins.title: Syra
pins.description: Syra. A cook. The ore barons are holding her captive.

pins.title: Talas
pins.description: Talas. Novice. Stuck at the Old Camp - he didn't manage to get the gurus their book.

pins.title: Baal Parvez
pins.description: Baal Parvez. He's looking for people to join the Brotherhood. Hangs around the marketplace in the Old Camp and preaches about the Sleeper.

pins.title: Baal Lukor
pins.description: Baal Lukor is a guru at the Swamp Camp. He stays in the temple with Y'Berion. What is his role? Mouthpiece, bodyguard— Whatever it is, he is definitely a close confidant.

pins.title: Joru
pins.description: Joru - a novice. He takes his time working his way up to the rank of baal. He insists on throughly testing the swampweed.

pins.title: Viran
pins.description: Viran is one of the swampweed harvesters at the Swamp Camp.

pins.title: Melvin
pins.description: Melvin. Escaped the Old Camp and became a novice.

pins.title: Balor
pins.description: Balor. One of the novices who gather swampweed.

pins.title: Cor Kalom
pins.description: Cor Kalom. The Swamp Camp's alchemist - also a guru. Most important man after Master Y'Berion. He brews the potions, including the one they need for the invocation of the Sleeper. He knows many secrets and seems to be close to the Sleeper. Very close.

pins.title: Baal Tondral
pins.description: Baal Tondral. Preaches the teachings of the Sleeper.

pins.title: Gor Na Ran
pins.description: Gor Na Ran. Templar and guard.

pins.title: Baal Namib
pins.description: Baal Namib. A guru at the Swamp Camp. Lingers by the camp entrance.

pins.title: Drake
pins.description: Drake is a warder at the Old Mine.

pins.title: Gor Na Kosh
pins.description: Gor Na Kosh. Templar at the Old Mine.

pins.title: Grimes
pins.description: Grimes. Digger at the Old Mine.

pins.title: Brandick
pins.description: Brandick - one of the warders at the Old Mine.

pins.title: Asghan
pins.description: Asghan. In charge of the warders at the Old Mine. Usually hangs around the bottom level of the mine.

pins.title: Gor Na Bar
pins.description: Gor Na Bar is a templar at the Old Mine.

pins.title: Ulbert
pins.description: A warder in the Old Mine. Name is Ulbert. He's guarding the storage.

pins.title: Gor Na Vid
pins.description: Gor Na Vid. Templar at the Old Mine.

pins.title: Snipes
pins.description: Snipes. One of the diggers at the Old Mine.

pins.title: Gor Na Drak
pins.description: Gor Na Drak. Templar. Brings minecrawler mandibles from the Old Mine to the Swamp Camp.

pins.title: Gilbert
pins.description: Gilbert. He's a hermit.

pins.title: Grazkrak
pins.description: Grazkrak. Orc warrior.

pins.title: Ur-Nazkrog
pins.description: Ur-Nazkrog. Head shaman at the Enclave.

pins.title: To-Churnagg
pins.description: To-Churnagg. Orc warrior chieftain.

pins.title: Umosh
pins.description: Umosh. An orc at the Enclave.

pins.title: Krashok
pins.description: Krashok is one of the guards at the Orc Enclave.

pins.title: Umakhal
pins.description: Umakhal. One of the orcs at the Enclave. Keeps following me around.

pins.title: Muk
pins.description: Muk is one of the orcs at the Enclave.

pins.title: Y'Berion
pins.description: Y'Berion is the spiritual leader of the Brotherhood of the Sleeper. He spoke to me as if he had known I would come. That calm, detached certainty of his- it's as if he can see the future.

pins.title: Cor Angar
pins.description: Cor Angar. Right-hand man of Master Y'Berion. Leader of the templars. He is direct, dutiful, and carries an air of solemn dignity.

pins.title: Natalia
pins.description: She lives in the temple, making sure everything is ready for the Sleeper.

pins.title: Chani
pins.description: Chani ended up at Swamp Camp as payment for a shipment of swamp weed. Despite everything, she seems to be a true believer in the Sleeper

pins.title: Gor Na Dun
pins.description: Gor Na Dun. He trains with the other templars.

pins.title: Ghorim
pins.description: Novice named Ghorim. He mashes swampweed at the Swamp Camp.

pins.title: Baal Orun
pins.description: A guru named Baal Orun. Usually hangs around the swampweed mashers. He watches the working novices.

pins.title: Harlok
pins.description: Harlok. Novice. One of the mashers at the Swamp Camp.

pins.title: Baal Tyon
pins.description: Baal Tyon. A guru at the Swamp Camp.

pins.title: Theron
pins.description: A novice called Theron. I met him out in the wilderness.

pins.title: Caine
pins.description: Caine. A novice and Cor Kalom's apprentice. He helps him brew the dreamjuice.

pins.title: Baal Netbek
pins.description: Baal Netbek is an eccentric novice. Hangs around in the swamp.

pins.title: Pacho
pins.description: Pacho - guards the way to the orc territory.

pins.title: Buster
pins.description: Buster - a bandit. Offered to teach me acrobatics.

pins.title: Rice Lord
pins.description: Rice Lord. He sits in his fortress and oversees the farmers' work from there. (Actual name is Hakon.)

pins.title: Ulmar
pins.description: Ulmar. Bandit, but mostly around the rice fields. He's handling the water for the farmers.

pins.title: Garp
pins.description: Garp - a digger at the Old Mine.

pins.description: Aleph - digger at the Old Mine.
